sources.title: Multi-Modal Emotion Classification using Late Fusion Model
sources.snippet: Multi-Modal Emotion Classification using Late Fusion Model Abstract: Emotion classification is essential for understanding human affective states. Multi-modal approaches integrate words, facial expressions, tone and context. Auxiliary metadata offer richer emotional context and help in better classification.
